description: تنظيف قاعدة الشركات: توحيد صيغة الإيميلات، وتعليم السجلات غير القابلة للتسليم أو المكررة أو التابعة لمنصات عالمية كـ Suppressed حتى لا تُرسل مرة أخرى.

parameters.content:
## BP — Sales DB Hygiene

Runs nightly at 03:00, ahead of the 10:00 send. Also safe to run by hand at any time.

**Why nightly:** BP — Apollo Enrich is active and keeps writing new email addresses into this database, so a one-off cleanup goes stale within a day.

**What it does**
1. Loads every record (duplicate detection needs the whole set).
2. Normalises each address — strips %20, mailto:, and multi-address strings.
3. Suppresses four classes of bad data:
   - Undeliverable Domain — DNS says the domain has no mail server.
   - Global Platform — booking.com, apps.apple.com, link/QR tools, hotel chains.
   - Placeholder — example@domain.com and friends left in a website template.
   - Duplicate — the same address on more than one record.
4. Fixes addresses that are salvageable and keeps the original in Email Fixed From.

**Nothing is deleted.** Suppressed rows stay with Suppressed = true and a reason, so the sender skips them and you can still audit them.

**Known limit:** the dead-domain list here is a snapshot from 2026-08-06. It does not cover domains Apollo adds later. The sender does a *live* MX lookup on every address just before sending, which is what actually covers new domains — this pass is the cheap bulk filter, not the last word.

**Watch for false positives** in Global Platform: the rule cannot tell "scraped from a platform" from "is the platform". Bayut KSA and Yaschools were both caught wrongly and restored by hand.

nodes.notes: Every row of BP — Companies Sales DB. No filter: duplicate detection needs the whole set.

nodes.name: Classify & Plan
nodes.notes: Normalises addresses, applies the dead/platform/placeholder lists, de-duplicates, and emits only the rows that need a write.

nodes.name: Mark Suppressed
nodes.notes: Suppressed = true + reason + Last Campaign Status = Skipped. The sender filters these out.

nodes.name: Fix Email
nodes.notes: Writes the normalised address back and keeps the original in Email Fixed From.
